author: Goodman71
quote:
Probably the worst GTA game ever played and I won’t just complain without brining substantial information. 
Without getting into spoiler, you’re playing a Real Life Simulator where after a hard Day of Work and having to handle your wife and girlfriend you end up playing as a submissed man who is bisexual (for some reason that was never developed further and doesn’t being anything to the story) gets cheated and girl bosses by his fellon baby mama, you spend the first 10h cleaning and doing the Groceries, painting and nonsense. You wake up after having shared some backshots with your homie to your fellon gf getting out of jail and her first move is to steal a car and create a fight and hit you for no reason. 

I won’t mention the story anymore because with the mutant Strawberry Hulk it is beyond ridicule without mentioning the Ufo that is horribly implemented.

The technique is great but there is absolute it 0 quality of world building or lore. I feel the same thing I’ve been feeling for the last couple years with GTA Online, bland safe edgy woke scripts that have neither reasons to exist or be. Not a GTA, will never be a GTA.
